package.description: Lightweight and modern desktop file shelf and workspace organizer for Windows.

en-US.description: Lightweight and modern desktop file shelf and workspace organizer for Windows.
en-US.longDescription:
KyteShelf is an elegant, multi-workspace desktop shelf for Windows.
It acts as a temporary holding zone and staging area for frequently accessed files, quick drag-and-drop actions, sticky notes, and tags.
en-US.name: KyteShelf
